summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (new TimeElapsedColumn after BarColumn; Task.finished_time field and finished property; capture in Progress.update and advance under the lock; clear in Task._reset and Progress.reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with local imports and TYPE_CHECKING-only Table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased/Added entry); tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns after TimeRemainingColumn, expected output regenerated by hand-traced clock reads: elapsed cells, bar widths 33->25 pending and 23->16 finished, speed 2 bytes/s->1 byte/s on bar); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast). Not verified by execution: please run pytest on tests/test_progress.py and tests/test_palette.py, since test_columns expected output was derived by hand.
